summary: Validated live Supabase invalid-login handling, initial session-safe rendering, backend health/protection, Alembic head, production build, and mobile overflow.
action_items: Change the rendered Sign out button to call the existing logout function so Supabase clears the persisted session, not only local React state.
Create a Supabase Auth test user before attempting authenticated employee/report CRUD or session-restore E2E.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js defines logout() with supabase.auth.signOut() but the rendered logout button calls only setLoggedIn(false); persisted Supabase sessions can therefore immediately restore after reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health returned 200, employees/reports without bearer returned 401, Alembic current was 20240603_factory_foundation (head), yarn build passed, and mobile document width equaled viewport. Invalid Supabase credentials showed 'Invalid login credentials'. No credentials exist in /app/memory/test_credentials.md, so authenticated session restore and CRUD remain untested. Employee/report screens are MOCKED/local demo state per request limitation.
rca of the issue: The logout handler is implemented but not wired to the button: App.js renders onClick={() => setLoggedIn(false)} instead of onClick={logout}. This leaves the Supabase persisted session intact; a reload can restore the user.
